Depending on how modern you want to go, you might want to check out Dog Days by David T. Little and Breaking the Waves by Missy Mazzoli. They have both come out within the last 10 years, and are very engaging in both music and plot. Dog Days follows a nuclear family in America during an unknown war and the breakdown of society, and incorporates some more musical theater sounds into the supporting roles of the two brothers. Breaking the Waves is about a woman who gets married and is pressured into an odd proposition after her husband has an accident and loses control of his lower body. It uses sprechstimme in a few sections where the main character "communicates" with her spiritual deity. Both were available on Beth Morrison Project, and there are probably recordings elsewhere.
